=== config
Register this stdio MCP server in your coding agent (start it in the project folder; a tool opened from the GUI may not have your PATH, hence the absolute paths):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agenthub": {
      "command": "<ROOT>/bin/py",
      "args": [
        "<ROOT>/bin/agenthub",
        "mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}

How to add it in each tool: docs/mcp.md. For a tool not started in the project folder, add AGENTHUB_PROJECT=<project name> to its env.
